create_random_cuboid_augmentation: create a RandomCuboid augmentation instance with min_points, aspect ratio, and crop range parameters
apply_random_cuboid_crop: apply random cuboid cropping to a point cloud with target bounding boxes and per-point labels
check_crop_aspect_ratio: check if a 3D crop range meets the minimum aspect ratio across xy, xz, or yz planes
augment_point_cloud_with_boxes: augment a point cloud by randomly cropping a cuboid that preserves at least one bounding box
filter_boxes_by_center: filter bounding boxes by keeping only those whose center lies within the cropped point cloud region
